copyPanel.formula: Area = (Number of Sides) × (Area of One Triangle)
steps: 1. Decompose the regular polygon from center into n congruent triangles
2. Find the area of one triangle using A = ½ × side × apothem (height)
3. Multiply by the total number of sides

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: The Rooftop Garden
revealWordProblem.text: The firm is designing a regular decagon-shaped rooftop garden bed. It decomposes into 10 congruent triangles from the center, each with a base of 3 feet and a height of 4 feet. The garden center charges $5 per square foot for soil and plants. What is the total cost to fill the garden bed?
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: One triangle: A = ½ × 3 × 4 = 6 sq ft. The decagon has 10 sides, so it has 10 triangles: 10 × 6 = 60 sq ft. Cost = 60 × $5 = $300.

questions.stem: A regular hexagon is divided into 6 equal triangles from the center. Each triangle has a base of 6 ft and a height of 5.2 ft. What is the area of one triangle?
questions.explanation: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 6 × 5.2 = 15.6 square feet.
choiceFeedback: 31.2 is 6 × 5.2 — the full rectangle. One triangle is half of that: multiply by ½.
11.2 comes from adding 6 + 5.2. Area means multiply base × height, then take half.
The number is right, but ft measures length. Area needs square units (sq ft).
hints: Focus on just ONE of the 6 triangles: its base is 6 ft and its height is 5.2 ft.
One triangle uses A = ½ × b × h — don't multiply by 6 yet; that step is for the whole hexagon.
Compute ½ × 6 × 5.2: take half of 6 first, then multiply by 5.2. Label it in sq ft.
questions.stemEs: Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos iguales desde el centro. Cada triángulo tiene una base de 6 ft y una altura de 5.2 ft. ¿Cuál es el área de un triángulo?
questions.explanationEs: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 6 × 5.2 = 15.6 pies cuadrados.
hintsEs: Concéntrate en solo UNO de los 6 triángulos: su base es de 6 pies y su altura de 5.2 pies.
Un triángulo usa A = ½ × b × h; todavía no multipliques por 6, ese paso es para el hexágono completo.
Calcula ½ × 6 × 5.2: saca primero la mitad de 6 y luego multiplica por 5.2. Etiquétalo en pies².

questions.stem: Using the triangle from the previous question, what is the total area of the hexagonal skylight?
questions.explanation: Total area = 6 triangles × 15.6 sq ft = 93.6 square feet.
choiceFeedback: That is the area of ONE of the congruent triangles. The hexagon is made of 6 of them — how many triangle areas do you still need to add?
You multiplied by 12 instead of 6. Count the congruent triangles the hexagon decomposes into before you multiply.
That is 4 triangles, not 6. Re-count how many congruent triangles the hexagon breaks into.
hints: You already found one triangle's area (15.6 sq ft) in the last question — now think about the whole hexagon.
A regular hexagon splits into 6 identical triangles, so the total is 6 copies of one triangle's area.
Multiply 15.6 × 6. (Tip: do 15 × 6, then 0.6 × 6, and combine.)
questions.stemEs: Usando el triángulo de la pregunta anterior, ¿cuál es el área total del tragaluz hexagonal?
questions.explanationEs: Área total = 6 triángulos × 15.6 pies cuadrados = 93.6 pies cuadrados.
hintsEs: Ya hallaste el área de un triángulo (15.6 pies²) en la pregunta anterior; ahora piensa en el hexágono completo.
Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos idénticos, así que el total son 6 copias del área de un triángulo.
Multiplica 15.6 × 6. (Consejo: haz 15 × 6, luego 0.6 × 6 y combina.)

questions.explanation: Each triangle: ½ × 4 × 3.5 = 7 sq cm. Total: 6 × 7 = 42 sq cm.

Use the right formula for each.

level2.sentenceFrame: One triangle's area is ½ × ___ × ___ = ___. The hexagon has ___ triangles so its area is ___. The pentagon has ___ triangles so its area is ___. The ___ has more area because ___.
level2.hint: Identify each shape; write area formula; add results.
hints: Both polygons use identical triangles (base 6 ft, height 5 ft) — only the NUMBER of triangles differs.
Find one triangle's area with ½ × 6 × 5, then multiply by 6 for the hexagon and by 5 for the pentagon.

level2.explanation: One triangle is ½ × 6 × 5 = 15 sq ft in both polygons, so the only difference is how many copies each shape holds: the hexagon has 6 for 90 sq ft and the pentagon has 5 for 75 sq ft. level3.explanationEs: Área total = 6 triángulos × 15.6 pies cuadrados = 93.6 pies cuadrados.
hintsEs: Ya hallaste el área de un triángulo (15.6 pies²) en la pregunta anterior; ahora piensa en el hexágono completo.
Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos idénticos, así que el total son 6 copias del área de un triángulo.

level3.stem: A regular hexagon is split into 6 triangles, each with base 4 cm and height 3.5 cm. What is the total area?
level3.explanation: Each triangle: ½ × 4 × 3.5 = 7 sq cm. Total: 6 × 7 = 42 sq cm.
choiceFeedback: Identify all simple shapes.

hints: Two stages hide here: first one triangle (base 4 cm, height 3.5 cm), then all 6 of them.
Use ½ × 4 × 3.5 for one triangle, then multiply that result by 6 for the hexagon.

level3.stemEs: Un hexágono regular se divide en 6 triángulos, cada uno con base 4 cm y altura 3.5 cm. ¿Cuál es el área total?

hintsEs: Aquí se esconden dos etapas: primero un triángulo (base 4 cm, altura 3.5 cm) y luego los 6 juntos.
Usa ½ × 4 × 3.5 para un triángulo y luego multiplica ese resultado por 6 para el hexágono.
